title: Remain
overview: When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

title: The Comeback King
overview: A country western star named Aubrey must return to college to earn his long-abandoned degree after a false rumor that he cheated on his girlfriend throws his career into free fall.

title: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
overview: Two children discover a wood full of pools leading to other worlds. One takes them to a dead city beneath a dying sun, where they wake a queen who exterminated its population and accidentally bring her back to London.

title: In a Violent Nature: Part 2
overview: Johnny heads to a summer camp, where he crosses paths with a young, outcast camper who is forced to spend the night with his counselor sister and her friends at their annual end-of-season party

title: The Last Resort
overview: A hotel executive is sent to scout a new location in the Philippines. Once there, she becomes captivated by the breathtaking scenery and the warmth of its people — and also meets Ben, a charming expatriate charter pilot.

title: Wishful Thinking
overview: Julia, an ambitious game designer, and Charlie, a struggling musician, are at a loss for how to repair their volatile relationship. After attending a couples-therapy seminar run by mysterious twin healers, they find that the ups-and-downs of their relationship have supernatural effects on the world around them. With earthquakes, the stock market, and entire nations at risk, Charlie and Julia must confront whether their passionate love can survive amidst so much chaos.

title: Slay Day
overview: On Friday the 13th, 1987, in the picture-perfect town of Belle Falls, six teens prepare for their biggest night of the year: the Sadie Hawkins dance. But when the town exhumes the body of the real Sadie Hawkins to unravel the truth behind her killing spree fifty years earlier, a malevolent force returns to the town.

title: Cassi
overview: Cassi is a waitress at a local diner whose life takes a dangerous turn when she romances a reclusive young mortician called Isaac. Their love quickly spirals into a murderous obsession, but with detectives hot on their tail, it forces Isaac to confront how much farther he's willing to go for Cassi.

title: Peter Is Here: Discovering the Origins
overview: Follow Chris Pratt as he explores the burial place and history of St. Peter beneath St. Peter's Basilica.

title: Ghosted
overview: Councilman Jamie Blake is used to leaving women in the dust—charming on the first few dates, then gone without a trace. But when he “ghosts” Arnelle, he finds himself haunted in the most literal sense.

title: Chase: A Documentary
overview: An intimate biographical look at Chase Pulumbarit, exploring his reality navigating an open bisexual identity, long before stepping into the local independent entertainment landscape. Driven by a deep, heartbreaking sense of isolation, the narrative captures the suffocating weight of expectations while living a truth he fears might break them.  The story dives into the profound loneliness of his daily life, tracing the bittersweet reality of staying authentic in a world that feels emotionally distant. It follows his fragile, late-night hustle as an unsigned dreamer, capturing the quiet despair of pouring his entire heart and pain into a blank screen, terrified that his voice will never be heard, and that he will always be left waiting at the doorstep of his dreams.

title: Sebastian Wasserberg's Big Day
overview: A ginger boy called Sebastian Wasserberg navigated secondary school while dealing with ladies, friends, hard drugs, and crime. One faithful day, he somehow accidently time travels and accidently kills Hitler, leading to insane consequences.

title: Wife & Dog
overview: The relentless greed of the Fairbank family and their associates fuels betrayal and murder in the battle for succession.

title: CoComelon: The Movie
overview: JJ embarks on the biggest adventure of his life: Kindergarten. But when, on his first day at school, JJ discovers that his beloved stuffed bear Boba has gone missing, JJ and his friends Cody, CeCe and Nina will begin a quest that will transport them into a magical land ruled by Princess Harmony, who has created a world with one rule: No singing.

title: Babies
overview: Struggling with the decision of whether or not to bring a child into the world, Annie and her husband Aaron become instant co-parents when their newly-divorced friend moves into their home with her 4-year-old. An ensemble comedy drama about the journey to parenthood... or not.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend
overview: Faced with the truth about Miori and Touko Kirishima, Sakuta must make a choice. This will be his final case of Adolescence Syndrome!

title: Panic Carefully

title: K-POP: The Debut
overview: Lizzy Lee, a young Korean-American woman, has spent her life following the path her family chose for her. But when she earns a spot in a globally televised competition to form the next K-pop girl group, she travels to Seoul, South Korea, to pursue the dream she must still keep hidden.

title: The Revenge of La Llorona
overview: A grieving mother's ancient curse targets a troubled family, forcing them to confront their own hidden past while fighting to survive her supernatural wrath.

title: Live Like That
overview: Based on an inspiring story about a family whose faith is tested by an unimaginable loss, and what they choose to do next, in the midst of grief, they make a surprising decision. Instead of responding with anger, they choose forgiveness and set out to help heal a divided community. What begins as private heartbreak becomes a broader movement of hope and connection, showing how faith, love, and unity can bring light even to the darkest moments.

title: Chasing Studios' The Final Film
overview: Grimey teams up with the multiverses to escape their simulation.
